sources.title: Memo B
sources.text: Memo B proposes a €310 budget and calls the date tentative. It does not claim approval. Neither memo is authoritative over the other.

sources.title: Review process
sources.text: The review process has this order: first record the proposal, then ask the reviewer for approval, and only after approval schedule the work. If approval is refused, do not schedule the work. There is no promised completion date.

cases.question: Create process steps only for the stated sequence. Include a separate factual source-supported order statement. Preserve the approval requirement, refusal condition and no promised completion date.
